obligations.description: The Customer shall pay INR 12,00,000 per year, invoiced quarterly.
obligations.responsible_party: Customer (Aegis Test Pvt Ltd)
obligations.recurrence_note: Annual fee of INR 12,00,000 invoiced quarterly.

citations.label: Clause 1 – Services and Fees
citations.quote: The Customer shall pay INR 12,00,000 per year, invoiced quarterly.

obligations.description: Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.
obligations.responsible_party: Customer (Aegis Test Pvt Ltd)
obligations.recurrence_note: Applies to each quarterly invoice issued.

citations.label: Clause 1 – Services and Fees
citations.quote: Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

obligations.description: Either party must give 60 days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term to prevent automatic renewal.
obligations.responsible_party: Either party (Acme Supplies Ltd or Aegis Test Pvt Ltd)
obligations.recurrence_note: Applies before the end of each 12-month renewal term.

citations.label: Clause 2 – Term and Renewal
citations.quote: It renews automatically for further 12-month terms unless either party gives 60 days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term.

obligations.description: The Supplier shall deliver a stock report within 10 business days after the end of each month.
obligations.responsible_party: Supplier (Acme Supplies Ltd)
obligations.recurrence_note: A stock report is due within 10 business days after the end of each calendar month.

citations.label: Clause 3 – Reports
citations.quote: The Supplier shall deliver a stock report within 10 business days after the end of each month.

obligations.description: Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret for 3 years after termination.
obligations.responsible_party: Both parties (Acme Supplies Ltd and Aegis Test Pvt Ltd)
obligations.recurrence_note: Ongoing duty lasting 3 years post-termination.

citations.label: Clause 5 – Confidentiality
citations.quote: Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret for 3 years after termination.

obligations.description: Either party may terminate for convenience by giving 30 days' written notice.
obligations.responsible_party: Either party (Acme Supplies Ltd or Aegis Test Pvt Ltd)
obligations.recurrence_note: Applies each time a party elects to terminate for convenience.

citations.label: Clause 6 – Termination
citations.quote: Either party may terminate for convenience on 30 days' written notice

obligations.description: A party in material breach must cure the breach within 15 days of notice, failing which the other party may terminate immediately.
obligations.responsible_party: Breaching party (Acme Supplies Ltd or Aegis Test Pvt Ltd)

timing.anchor_text: material breach not cured within 15 days

obligations.recurrence_note: Applies per occurrence of material breach.

citations.label: Clause 6 – Termination
citations.quote: or immediately for material breach not cured within 15 days
